title: Ban cap nhat v1.6.3 - Ho tro doi IP tung Group (0..5) va doi IP TAT CA cac Group
releaseNotes:
- Nang cap o chon Group thanh ComboBox tien loi: Chon Group 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 hoac Tat ca cac Group (1..5)
- Them nut 'Doi ALL Group' va 'Doi IP Group' de doi IP linh hoat theo y muon
- Them menu chuot phai tren bang thiet bi va tren man hinh DeviceView de doi IP Group may nay hoac TAT CA Group
- Dong bo tinh nang tren ca Form chinh va Form Login 2FA
